children: Michelle Bowman, Vice Chair for Supervision of the Fed's Board of Governors said the Fed will consider final revisions to the Board's stress testing framework in the 'coming weeks'. "These changes will improve transparency and public accountability, strengthen the reliability and accuracy of the models, and reduce the volatility of the capital requirements flowing from the annual stress test results," Bowman said when delivering remarks in London. (jessica.coacci@wsj.com)
